name: Anjeer Dryfruits Punch – 450g

faqs.question: What ingredients are highlighted in Anjeer Punch?
faqs.answer: The catalog highlights the rich, nutty flavor of dried figs (anjeer) combined with assorted dry fruits bound into a sweet roll format.

faqs.question: How does it differ from Dates Punch?
faqs.answer: Anjeer Punch is led by dried figs which provide a characteristic fig crunch, whereas Dates Punch uses a base of dates.
